END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 3: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) OPTICAL PYROMETRY VOTING ENGINE        *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Calculate pairwise absolute temperature discrepancies *)
lrDev_12 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2);
lrDev_23 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3);
lrDev_31 := ABS(lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3 - lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1);

(* Channel 1 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_12 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_31 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P1 := udiFaultBucket_P1 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P1 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P1 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P1 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P1 := udiFaultBucket_P1 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P1 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P1 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P1 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Channel 2 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_12 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_23 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P2 := udiFaultBucket_P2 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P2 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P2 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P2 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P2 := udiFaultBucket_P2 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P2 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P2 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P2 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Channel 3 Leaky-Bucket Fault Integrator *)
IF (lrDev_23 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) AND (lrDev_31 > lrPyrometerDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
    udiFaultBucket_P3 := udiFaultBucket_P3 + 5;
    lrHealthScore_P3 := MAX(0.0, lrHealthScore_P3 - 2.5);
ELSE
    IF udiFaultBucket_P3 > 1 THEN
        udiFaultBucket_P3 := udiFaultBucket_P3 - 1;
    ELSE
        udiFaultBucket_P3 := 0;
    END_IF;
    lrHealthScore_P3 := MIN(100.0, lrHealthScore_P3 + 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Sensor trip latching *)
IF udiFaultBucket_P1 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP1_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000100; (* Pyrometer 1 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;
IF udiFaultBucket_P2 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP2_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000200; (* Pyrometer 2 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;
IF udiFaultBucket_P3 >= udiPyrometerBucketTripLimit THEN
    bP3_Healthy := FALSE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000400; (* Pyrometer 3 Fault Bit *)
END_IF;

(* Count active operational channels *)
nActivePyrometers := 0;
IF bP1_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;
IF bP2_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;
IF bP3_Healthy THEN nActivePyrometers := nActivePyrometers + 1; END_IF;

(* TMR Consensus Temperature Computation *)
IF nActivePyrometers = 3 THEN
    (* Fully redundant 2oo3 median selection *)
    IF ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3)) OR
       ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2)) THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1;
    ELSIF ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3)) OR
          ((lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 >= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) AND (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 <= lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1)) THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2;
    ELSE
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3;
    END_IF;
    bProcessDegraded := FALSE;
ELSIF nActivePyrometers = 2 THEN
    (* Graceful degradation to 1oo2 dual-sensor arithmetic average *)
    bProcessDegraded := TRUE;
    nDegradationMode := 1; (* 1oo2 mode *)
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#08000000; (* Degraded 1oo2 mode active *)
    IF NOT bP1_Healthy THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    ELSIF NOT bP2_Healthy THEN
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer3) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted := (lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer1 + lrSubstrateTemp_Pyrometer2) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Complete voting failure: less than 2 sensors valid *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
    bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
    bCNCHaltFeedCommand := TRUE;
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000800; (* 2oo3 consensus failure bit *)
    iState := 900; (* Controlled fault abort *)
END_IF;

(* Extreme melt pool temperature boundary checks *)
IF lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted > 1850.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000040; (* Over-temperature flash *)
    bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
    iState := 900;
ELSIF (iState = 50) AND (lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted < 1180.0) THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000080; (* Under-temperature lack-of-fusion *)
END_IF;

(* Spindle Ceramic Bearing Thermal Consensus *)
lrBearingDiscrepancy := ABS(lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing - lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing);
lrSpindleBearingTemp_Voted := MAX(lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing, lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing);
IF (lrSpindleTemp_FrontBearing > 58.0) OR (lrSpindleTemp_RearBearing > 52.0) THEN
    udiBearingFaultCounter := udiBearingFaultCounter + 1;
    IF udiBearingFaultCounter > 50 THEN
        bSpindleBearingOverheat := TRUE;
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00010000; (* Front/rear bearing thermal runaway *)
        bInterlockTripped := TRUE;
        iState := 900;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    IF udiBearingFaultCounter > 0 THEN udiBearingFaultCounter := udiBearingFaultCounter - 1; END_IF;
    bSpindleBearingOverheat := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 4: CONTINUOUS-DISCRETE THERMAL EXPANSION STATE-SPACE SOLVER                    *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Vector Input Synthesis *)
(* Input 1: Spindle frictional heat generation [W] *)
aThermal_U[1] := (lrSpindleSpeed_Act * 0.00028 * lrSpindleSpeed_Act) + (lrSpindleCuttingForce_Norm * 0.125);

(* Input 2: Laser cladding head absorbed thermal dissipation [W] *)
aThermal_U[2] := (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.042) + (lrOpticsHeadTemp - 20.0) * 1.85;

(* Input 3: Machine frame ambient delta temperature [deg C] *)
aThermal_U[3] := lrAmbientTemp - 20.0;

(* Compute State Derivatives dx/dt = A * x + B * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    lrTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_A[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_X[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_U[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aThermal_X_Dot[iIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Numerical Forward-Euler Integration over Cycle Time *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    aThermal_X[iIdx] := aThermal_X[iIdx] + (aThermal_X_Dot[iIdx] * lrCycleTime_Sec);
    (* Bound state vectors against unphysical numerical divergence *)
    IF aThermal_X[iIdx] > 450.0 THEN
        aThermal_X[iIdx] := 450.0;
    ELSIF aThermal_X[iIdx] < -150.0 THEN
        aThermal_X[iIdx] := -150.0;
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Output Observation Vector y = C * x + D * u *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
    lrTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 6 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_C[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_X[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aThermal_D[iIdx, jIdx] * aThermal_U[jIdx]);
    END_FOR;
    aThermal_Y[iIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 5: 5-AXIS KINEMATIC DECOUPLING & TOOL CENTER POINT (TCP) JACOBIAN CORRECTION   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Determine active tool center point based on operating modality *)
IF bHybridModeSelect THEN
    (* Subtractive Milling Mode: Tool length coupled to high-speed spindle shaft *)
    (* Axis X Offset: Spindle radial expansion X + column tilt *)
    aKin_Jacobian[1, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] + aThermal_Y[6] * 0.15);
    (* Axis Y Offset: Spindle radial expansion Y *)
    aKin_Jacobian[2, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3]);
    (* Axis Z Offset: Spindle axial growth + machine bed thermal expansion *)
    aKin_Jacobian[3, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[1] + aThermal_Y[6]);
    (* Rotary A-Axis Tilt Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[4, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3] / lrSpindleLength_Nominal) * 1000.0;
    (* Rotary C-Axis Table Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[5, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] / lrSpindleLength_Nominal) * 1000.0;
ELSE
    (* Additive DED Cladding Mode: Optical head standoff coupled to laser nozzle *)
    (* Axis X Offset: Optical head radial drift *)
    aKin_Jacobian[1, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[2] * 0.35 + aThermal_Y[6] * 0.12);
    (* Axis Y Offset: Optical head radial drift *)
    aKin_Jacobian[2, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[3] * 0.35);
    (* Axis Z Offset: Collimator thermal dilation + nozzle standoff drift + bed displacement *)
    aKin_Jacobian[3, 1] := -(aThermal_Y[4] + aThermal_Y[5] + aThermal_Y[6]);
    (* Rotary A-Axis Tilt Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[4, 1] := 0.0;
    (* Rotary C-Axis Table Compensation [mrad] *)
    aKin_Jacobian[5, 1] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Apply 1st-Order Low-Pass Butterworth/Exponential Smoothing on Offsets *)
FOR iIdx := 1 TO 5 DO
    aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx] := aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx] +
        lrFilterCoeff_Kin * (aKin_Jacobian[iIdx, 1] - aKin_Offset_Filtered[iIdx]);
END_FOR;

(* Route Filtered Offsets to Actuator Output Interface *)
lrTCP_Offset_X := aKin_Offset_Filtered[1];
lrTCP_Offset_Y := aKin_Offset_Filtered[2];
lrTCP_Offset_Z := aKin_Offset_Filtered[3];
lrTCP_Offset_A := aKin_Offset_Filtered[4];
lrTCP_Offset_C := aKin_Offset_Filtered[5];

(* Check for excessive kinematic thermal drift exceeding allowable tolerance *)
IF (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_Z) > 180.0) OR (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_X) > 120.0) OR (ABS(lrTCP_Offset_Y) > 120.0) THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00400000; (* TCP Thermal drift out of bounds *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 6: IN-SITU OPTICAL PROFILOMETRY DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER (EKF)                   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* A Priori State Prediction x_prior = A_kf * x + B_kf * u *)
aKF_X_Prior[1] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * aKF_X[1]) + (aKF_A[1, 2] * aKF_X[2]) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 1] * (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.001)) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 2] * (lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated * 0.1)) +
                  (aKF_B[1, 3] * (lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated * 0.001));

aKF_X_Prior[2] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * aKF_X[1]) + (aKF_A[2, 2] * aKF_X[2]) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 1] * (lrLaserPower_Modulated * 0.001)) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 2] * (lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated * 0.1)) +
                  (aKF_B[2, 3] * (lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated * 0.001));

(* A Priori Error Covariance Prediction P_prior = A_kf * P * A_kf^T + Q_kf *)
aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[1, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) + aKF_Q[1, 1];

aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] := (aKF_A[1, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[1, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) + aKF_Q[1, 2];

aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[2, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[1, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[1, 2])) + aKF_Q[2, 1];

aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] := (aKF_A[2, 1] * (aKF_P[1, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[1, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) +
                     (aKF_A[2, 2] * (aKF_P[2, 1]*aKF_A[2, 1] + aKF_P[2, 2]*aKF_A[2, 2])) + aKF_Q[2, 2];

(* Innovation / Measurement Residual Evaluation *)
aKF_Innov[1] := lrOpticalProfilometer_Z - aKF_X_Prior[1];
aKF_Innov[2] := lrOpticalProfilometer_W - aKF_X_Prior[2];

(* Innovation Covariance S = P_prior + R_kf *)
aKF_S[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_R[1, 1];
aKF_S[1, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_R[1, 2];
aKF_S[2, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] + aKF_R[2, 1];
aKF_S[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] + aKF_R[2, 2];

(* Determinant of 2x2 Innovation Matrix *)
lrDet := (aKF_S[1, 1] * aKF_S[2, 2]) - (aKF_S[1, 2] * aKF_S[2, 1]);

IF ABS(lrDet) > 1.0E-6 THEN
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 1] :=  aKF_S[2, 2] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 2] := -aKF_S[1, 2] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 1] := -aKF_S[2, 1] / lrDet;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 2] :=  aKF_S[1, 1] / lrDet;
ELSE
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 1] := 0.05;
    aKF_S_Inv[1, 2] := 0.0;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 1] := 0.0;
    aKF_S_Inv[2, 2] := 0.03;
END_IF;

(* Chi-Square Mahalanobis Distance Gating: gamma = y^T * S^-1 * y *)
lrChiSquareDistance := (aKF_Innov[1] * (aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]*aKF_Innov[1] + aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]*aKF_Innov[2])) +
                       (aKF_Innov[2] * (aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]*aKF_Innov[1] + aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]*aKF_Innov[2]));

IF (lrChiSquareDistance <= lrChiSquareThreshold) AND bProfilometerSignalValid THEN
    (* Measurement is physically valid - compute optimal Kalman gain K = P_prior * S^-1 *)
    bProfilometerGated := FALSE;
    aKF_K[1, 1] := (aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]) + (aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]);
    aKF_K[1, 2] := (aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]) + (aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]);
    aKF_K[2, 1] := (aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 1]) + (aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 1]);
    aKF_K[2, 2] := (aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] * aKF_S_Inv[1, 2]) + (aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] * aKF_S_Inv[2, 2]);

    (* A Posteriori State Estimate Update x = x_prior + K * y *)
    aKF_X[1] := aKF_X_Prior[1] + (aKF_K[1, 1] * aKF_Innov[1]) + (aKF_K[1, 2] * aKF_Innov[2]);
    aKF_X[2] := aKF_X_Prior[2] + (aKF_K[2, 1] * aKF_Innov[1]) + (aKF_K[2, 2] * aKF_Innov[2]);

    (* Joseph Form Error Covariance Update: P = (I - K)*P_prior*(I - K)^T + K*R*K^T *)
    aKF_P[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] - ((aKF_K[1, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_K[1, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 1]));
    aKF_P[1, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] - ((aKF_K[1, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_K[1, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 2]));
    aKF_P[2, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 1] - ((aKF_K[2, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + aKF_K[2, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 1]));
    aKF_P[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] - ((aKF_K[2, 1]*aKF_P_Prior[1, 2] + aKF_K[2, 2]*aKF_P_Prior[2, 2]));

    IF udiProfilometerFaultCounter > 0 THEN
        udiProfilometerFaultCounter := udiProfilometerFaultCounter - 1;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Outlier / Optical flare rejected: propagate purely on model prediction *)
    bProfilometerGated := TRUE;
    aKF_X[1] := aKF_X_Prior[1];
    aKF_X[2] := aKF_X_Prior[2];
    aKF_P[1, 1] := aKF_P_Prior[1, 1] + 1.5;
    aKF_P[2, 2] := aKF_P_Prior[2, 2] + 2.5;
    udiProfilometerFaultCounter := udiProfilometerFaultCounter + 1;

    IF udiProfilometerFaultCounter > 150 THEN
        (* Persistent profilometer failure -> degrade to open loop *)
        bProcessDegraded := TRUE;
        nDegradationMode := 2; (* Open loop geometry mode *)
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00001000; (* Profilometer signal invalid *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Route Filtered Estimates to Functional Outputs *)
lrCladHeight_Estimated := aKF_X[1];
lrCladWidth_Estimated := aKF_X[2];

(* Process Quality Tolerance Band Verification *)
IF ABS(lrCladHeight_Estimated - lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint) > 220.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00002000; (* Height deviation out of specification *)
END_IF;
IF ABS(lrCladWidth_Estimated - lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint) > 350.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00004000; (* Width deviation out of specification *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 7: ROSENTHAL MOVING HEAT SOURCE & TRANSIENT THERMAL STRESS OVERRIDE            *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Evaluate velocity in coherent metric units [mm / s] *)
lrTempSum := MAX(1.0, lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated) / 60.0;

(* Spatial Metric Calculation for Trailing Heat Affected Zone (HAZ) *)
lrMovingCoord_Xi := -3.2;
lrObservationRadius_R := SQRT((lrMovingCoord_Xi * lrMovingCoord_Xi) + (1.2 * 1.2) + (0.6 * 0.6));

(* Rosenthal Analytical Formulation: T = T0 + [eta*P / (2*pi*k*R)] * exp(-v*(R+xi)/(2*alpha)) *)
lrRosenthalTerm1 := -(lrTempSum * (lrObservationRadius_R + lrMovingCoord_Xi)) / (2.0 * lrThermalDiffusivity_alpha);
IF lrRosenthalTerm1 < -22.0 THEN
    lrRosenthalTerm1 := -22.0; (* Prevent floating-point underflow *)
ELSIF lrRosenthalTerm1 > 0.0 THEN
    lrRosenthalTerm1 := 0.0;
END_IF;

lrRosenthalTerm2 := 2.0 * 3.14159265358979 * lrThermalConductivity_k * lrObservationRadius_R;
IF lrRosenthalTerm2 > 1.0E-6 THEN
    lrRosenthalTemp := lrAmbientTemp + ((lrLaserAbsorptionEfficiency * lrLaserPower_Modulated) / lrRosenthalTerm2) * EXP(lrRosenthalTerm1);
ELSE
    lrRosenthalTemp := lrAmbientTemp;
END_IF;

(* Bound temperature against extreme calculation artefacts *)
lrRosenthalTemp := MIN(1650.0, MAX(lrAmbientTemp, lrRosenthalTemp));
IF lrRosenthalTemp > lrPeakMeltTempObserved_degC THEN
    lrPeakMeltTempObserved_degC := lrRosenthalTemp;
END_IF;

(* Plane Strain Thermal Stress Calculation *)
lrThermalExpansionDelta := lrCoeffThermalExpansion_alpha_E * (lrRosenthalTemp - 20.0);
lrStress_Sigma_XX := -((lrYoungsModulus_E * lrThermalExpansionDelta) / (1.0 - lrPoissonRatio_nu)) * 0.745;
lrStress_Sigma_YY := -((lrYoungsModulus_E * lrThermalExpansionDelta) / (1.0 - lrPoissonRatio_nu)) * 0.512;
lrStress_Tau_XY := ((lrYoungsModulus_E / (2.0 * (1.0 + lrPoissonRatio_nu))) * lrThermalExpansionDelta) * 0.235;

(* Equivalent Von Mises Stress: sigma_vm = sqrt(s_xx^2 - s_xx*s_yy + s_yy^2 + 3*t_xy^2) *)
lrStress_VonMises := SQRT((lrStress_Sigma_XX * lrStress_Sigma_XX) -
                         (lrStress_Sigma_XX * lrStress_Sigma_YY) +
                         (lrStress_Sigma_YY * lrStress_Sigma_YY) +
                         (3.0 * lrStress_Tau_XY * lrStress_Tau_XY));

lrEstimatedResidualStress := lrStress_VonMises;
IF lrStress_VonMises > lrPeakStressObserved_MPa THEN
    lrPeakStressObserved_MPa := lrStress_VonMises;
END_IF;

(* Temperature-Softened Instantaneous Material Yield Strength *)
lrDynamicYieldStrength := MAX(220.0, lrYieldStrength_Base - (lrThermalSofteningCoeff * (lrRosenthalTemp - 20.0)));
lrAdaptiveStressRatio := lrStress_VonMises / lrDynamicYieldStrength;

(* Adaptive Feedrate Override Characteristic Law *)
IF lrAdaptiveStressRatio > 0.82 THEN
    (* Approaching plastic deformation / hot cracking boundary -> decelerate feed to expand HAZ/reduce gradient *)
    lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.0 - (1.15 * (lrAdaptiveStressRatio - 0.82) * SQRT(lrAdaptiveStressRatio - 0.82));
    IF lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor < 0.20 THEN
        lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 0.20;
    END_IF;
    IF lrAdaptiveStressRatio >= 0.96 THEN
        udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00100000; (* Severe thermal stress cracking hazard *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Low-stress regime -> allow slight feed acceleration up to 115% for productivity *)
    lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.0 + (0.15 * (0.82 - lrAdaptiveStressRatio));
    IF lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor > 1.15 THEN
        lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor := 1.15;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 8: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) RECEDING HORIZON QUADRATIC COST SOLVER       *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* Setpoint Reference Trajectory Vector *)
aMPC_X_Ref[1] := lrMeltPoolTemp_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[2] := lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[3] := lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint;
aMPC_X_Ref[4] := MIN(350.0, lrMaxPermissibleThermalStress * 0.65);

(* Horizon Root State Initialization x_hat[0] *)
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 1] := lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 2] := lrCladHeight_Estimated;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 3] := lrCladWidth_Estimated;
aMPC_X_Hat[0, 4] := lrStress_VonMises;

(* Warm-Start Control Trajectory with Slew-Rate Bounded Baseline *)
IF NOT bMPC_Initialized THEN
    aMPC_U_Prev[1] := lrLaserPower_Cmd;
    aMPC_U_Prev[2] := lrPowderMassFlow_Act;
    aMPC_U_Prev[3] := lrTraverseFeedrate_Cmd;
END_IF;

FOR kIdx := 0 TO 4 DO
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 1] := aMPC_U_Prev[1];
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 2] := aMPC_U_Prev[2];
    aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, 3] := aMPC_U_Prev[3];
END_FOR;

(* Forward State Rollout over Prediction Horizon N=5: x[k+1] = A_mpc*x[k] + B_mpc*u[k] *)
FOR kIdx := 0 TO 4 DO
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        lrTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_A[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_X_Hat[kIdx, jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
            lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_U_Hat[kIdx, jIdx]);
        END_FOR;
        aMPC_X_Hat[kIdx + 1, iIdx] := lrTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Analytical Gradient Computation of Quadratic Cost J(u_0) *)
FOR jIdx := 1 TO 3 DO
    (* Control effort penalty term *)
    lrTempSum := aMPC_R[jIdx] * (aMPC_U_Hat[0, jIdx] - aMPC_U_Prev[jIdx]) +
                 aMPC_S[jIdx] * (aMPC_U_Hat[0, jIdx] - aMPC_U_Prev[jIdx]);
    (* Backward sensitivity propagation across stage 1 and 2 *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_B[iIdx, jIdx] * aMPC_Q[iIdx] * (aMPC_X_Hat[1, iIdx] - aMPC_X_Ref[iIdx]));
        lrTempSum := lrTempSum + (aMPC_A[iIdx, 1] * aMPC_B[1, jIdx] * aMPC_Q[iIdx] * (aMPC_X_Hat[2, iIdx] - aMPC_X_Ref[iIdx]) * 0.45);
    END_FOR;
    aMPC_Grad[jIdx] := lrTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Accelerated Projected Gradient Descent Step *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[1]);
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[2]);
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] - (lrMPC_StepSize * aMPC_Grad[3]);

(* Enforce Hard Box Constraints on Physical Actuators *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := MIN(lrLaserPower_Max, MAX(lrLaserPower_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1]));
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := MIN(lrPowderFlow_Max, MAX(lrPowderFlow_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2]));
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := MIN(lrFeedrate_Max, MAX(lrFeedrate_Min, aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3]));

(* Enforce Dynamic Slew-Rate Limits [Delta_u / dt] *)
aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[1] + (lrLaserPower_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[1] - (lrLaserPower_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1]));

aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[2] + (lrPowderFlow_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[2] - (lrPowderFlow_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2]));

aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] := MIN(aMPC_U_Prev[3] + (lrFeedrate_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec),
                       MAX(aMPC_U_Prev[3] - (lrFeedrate_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec), aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3]));

(* Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) Optimality Residual Check *)
lrGradNorm := SQRT((aMPC_Grad[1] * aMPC_Grad[1]) + (aMPC_Grad[2] * aMPC_Grad[2]) + (aMPC_Grad[3] * aMPC_Grad[3]));
lrKKT_ResidualNorm := lrGradNorm;
IF lrGradNorm > 850.0 THEN
    udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#04000000; (* MPC QP divergence / KKT boundary violation *)
END_IF;

(* Update Previous Input Vector for Next Cycle Recursion *)
aMPC_U_Prev[1] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1];
aMPC_U_Prev[2] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2];
aMPC_U_Prev[3] := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3];

(* ==================================================================================== *)
(* BLOCK 9: MASTER MULTI-STAGE HIERARCHICAL HYBRID CELL STATE MACHINE                   *)
(* ==================================================================================== *)
CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE_CELL_INITIALIZATION: Initial power-up, bus sync, safe homing *)
        bCellReady := FALSE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 0.0;
        bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000000;
        IF bCellEnable AND bEmergencyStop AND NOT bLatchedHardwareTrip THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Standby *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CELL_STANDBY: Safety circuits OK, chillers nominal, waiting for trigger *)
        bCellReady := TRUE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 2.0; (* Baseline purge flow *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000002; (* Standby Ready *)
        IF NOT bCellEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        ELSIF bCellEnable AND NOT bHybridModeSelect THEN
            iState := 20; (* Launch Additive DED Cladding Sequence *)
        ELSIF bCellEnable AND bHybridModeSelect THEN
            iState := 90; (* Launch Subtractive 5-Axis Milling Sequence *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_DED_ALIGNMENT_AND_PURGE: Optical head purge & gas flow stabilization *)
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 16.0; (* Co-axial argon shroud setpoint [L/min] *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000010; (* DED Purging *)
        tonGasPurge(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3500MS);
        IF tonGasPurge.Q THEN
            tonGasPurge(IN := FALSE);
            IF (lrShieldGasFlowRate_Act >= 14.0) AND (lrCarrierGasPressure_Act >= 3.8) THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to powder stabilization *)
            ELSE
                udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000008; (* Shield gas flow low *)
                iState := 900; (* Controlled fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_DED_POWDER_STABILIZATION: Powder disc rotation & fluidization check *)
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 12.5;
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000020; (* DED Powder Priming *)
        tonPowderStabilize(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2500MS);
        IF tonPowderStabilize.Q THEN
            tonPowderStabilize(IN := FALSE);
            IF ABS(lrPowderMassFlow_Act - 12.5) <= 1.2 THEN
                iState := 40; (* Proceed to laser ignition *)
            ELSE
                udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00000020; (* Powder feeder rate unstable *)
                iState := 900;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_DED_LASER_RAMP_AND_IGNITION: Open shutter, ignite melt pool at pilot power *)
        bInterlockShutterClosed := FALSE;
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 850.0; (* Pilot ignition laser power [W] *)
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 120.0; (* Lead-in creep velocity [mm/min] *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000040; (* DED Laser Firing *)
        IF lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted >= 1320.0 THEN
            iState := 50; (* Melt pool established -> Engage full closed-loop deposition *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_DED_CLOSED_LOOP_DEPOSITION: Active MPC cladding with adaptive stress override *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000080; (* DED Closed Loop Active *)
        (* Feed MPC modulated setpoints with adaptive stress scaling *)
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 1];
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 2];
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := aMPC_U_Hat[0, 3] * lrAdaptiveOverrideFactor;

        (* Accumulate process metrics *)
        lrTotalLaserEnergy_kJ := lrTotalLaserEnergy_kJ + (lrLaserPower_Modulated * lrCycleTime_Sec * 0.001);
        lrTotalPowderConsumed_g := lrTotalPowderConsumed_g + ((lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated / 60.0) * lrCycleTime_Sec);

        IF bCladdingPassCompleted THEN
            udiTotalCladdingTracksDone := udiTotalCladdingTracksDone + 1;
            iState := 60; (* Proceed to bead tail ramp-down *)
        ELSIF nDegradationMode >= 3 THEN
            iState := 140; (* Divert to degraded process recovery *)
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_DED_BEAD_TAIL_EXTINCTION: Controlled crater-fill power ramp to avoid keyhole porosity *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000100; (* DED Crater Fill *)
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        IF lrLaserPower_Modulated > 200.0 THEN
            lrLaserPower_Modulated := lrLaserPower_Modulated - (lrLaserPower_SlewMax * lrCycleTime_Sec);
        ELSE
            lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
            bInterlockShutterClosed := TRUE;
            iState := 70; (* Move to post-clad metrology scan *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_DED_OPTICAL_METROLOGY_SCAN: In-situ full-track profilometer audit *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000200; (* Profilometry Audit *)
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 400.0; (* Steady inspection scan velocity *)
        IF (ABS(lrCladHeight_Estimated - lrTargetLayerHeight_Setpoint) <= 120.0) AND
           (ABS(lrCladWidth_Estimated - lrTargetTrackWidth_Setpoint) <= 180.0) THEN
            iState := 80; (* Thermal cooldown transition *)
        ELSE
            udiAlarmMaskHigh := udiAlarmMaskHigh OR 16#00000001; (* Layer geometry out of nominal tolerance *)
            iState := 80;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_COOLING_TRANSITION: Gas-assisted cooldown prior to subtractive milling *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00000400; (* Thermal Stabilization *)
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 22.0; (* High-flow cooling shroud *)
        tonCoolingTransition(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4000MS);
        IF tonCoolingTransition.Q THEN
            tonCoolingTransition(IN := FALSE);
            IF lrMeltPoolTemp_Voted <= 220.0 THEN
                lrShieldGasFlow_Set := 2.0;
                iState := 130; (* Check layer accumulation or switch to milling *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_CNC_TOOL_PROBE_AND_TCP_HANDOVER: Handover thermal offsets to 5-axis CNC controller *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00001000; (* CNC Datum & Offset Handshake *)
        lrLaserPower_Modulated := 0.0;
        lrPowderMassFlow_Modulated := 0.0;
        (* Handshake offset vector verified *)
        IF ABS(lrTCP_Offset_Z) < 180.0 THEN
            iState := 100; (* Spindle ramp-up *)
        ELSE
            udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00400000; (* Kinematic offset excessive *)
            iState := 900;
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE_CNC_SPINDLE_ACCEL_AND_ENGAGE: High-speed ceramic bearing spindle acceleration *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00002000; (* Spindle Accelerating *)
        tonSpindleSpinUp(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3000MS);
        IF tonSpindleSpinUp.Q THEN
            tonSpindleSpinUp(IN := FALSE);
            IF lrSpindleSpeed_Act >= 11500.0 THEN
                iState := 110; (* Active 5-axis machining *)
            ELSE
                udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00080000; (* Spindle failed to reach speed *)
                iState := 900;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE_CNC_5AXIS_MILLING_ACTIVE: High-speed contour finishing with force override *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00004000; (* 5-Axis Milling In Progress *)
        (* Adaptive Subtractive Feedrate based on cutting dynamometer load *)
        IF lrSpindleCuttingForce_Norm > 850.0 THEN
            lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := lrTraverseFeedrate_Cmd * 0.65; (* Reduce feed on tool deflection *)
            udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter := udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter + 1;
        ELSIF lrSpindleCuttingForce_Norm > 1200.0 THEN
            udiAlarmMaskLow := udiAlarmMaskLow OR 16#00040000; (* Cutter severe overload *)
            iState := 900;
        ELSE
            lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := lrTraverseFeedrate_Cmd;
            IF udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter > 0 THEN udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter := udiCuttingOverforceFaultCounter - 1; END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Subtractive volumetric accumulation *)
        lrTotalMillingVolume_mm3 := lrTotalMillingVolume_mm3 + ((lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated / 60.0) * 0.45 * 1.8 * lrCycleTime_Sec);
        IF bMillingPassCompleted THEN
            udiTotalMillingPassesDone := udiTotalMillingPassesDone + 1;
            iState := 120; (* Retract spindle *)
        END_IF;

    120: (* STATE_CNC_RETRACT_AND_CLEANING: Spindle deceleration & chip evacuation *)
        dwCellStatusWord := 16#00008000; (* Tool Retract & Cleaning *)
        lrTraverseFeedrate_Modulated := 0.0;
        IF lrSpindleSpeed_Act <= 500.0 THEN
